title: Cultists of the Ancient Ones, the interface art: the twelve unit portraits (the summoned things included), the three technology icons, the eighteen command and ability icons and the ten HUD and status icons (the Favour candle at two sizes)

recipes.promptAddendum: A close-up bust: the hooded head and the shoulders fill the whole square; no legs. The cloth is a bright saturated royal blue, clearly blue and much lighter than the black outline, never grey, charcoal, navy or black. The hood's opening is pure black with only the two eyes in it.
recipes.negativeAddendum: full body, legs, feet, skin, face, nose, mouth, beard, skull face, skeleton, grey hood, black robe, staff, wand, dagger
recipes.notes: Portrait sample: a fresh creation with the portrait class and the close-up addendum of the Dwarf and Candy portraits; the cloth is asked for as royal blue so the cult-lodge accent makes it the lodge's indigo.

recipes.editInstruction: Change only two things: the two big eyes become plain round cream-white ovals with no pupils and no black dots inside them; the grey hand under the candle becomes a pale cream mitten. Do not redraw anything else: keep the blue hood with its floppy tip, the black hood opening, the candle with its green flame, the brass badge, the thick black outline and the art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
recipes.notes: portrait-initiate-a is the right bust, but its eyes have pupils and the hand on the candle is grey: the map sprite has plain cream eyes and cream mittens.
